fullPassage: The difficult times that we endure play a key role in helping us to lead more meaningful lives. As Jean-Paul Sartre put it, "Human life begins on the far side of despair." That is, many of the ways people feel their lives are meaningful are grounded in the sufferings they have experienced. One research project investigated the differences between people who found their lives to be happy and those who found them to be meaningful. While, on average, happy lives and meaningful lives overlap a great deal, the researchers focused on those aspects of a meaningful life that were distinct from happiness. And, remarkably, they found that people who had more meaningful lives reported that they had more experience suffering through past negative events. They also reported worrying more and enduring more things that caused them stress. On the other hand, these past experiences with suffering tended to reduce people's overall levels of happiness. Our sufferings, then, seem to help to provide people with the sense that their lives are more meaningful, even if these events are associated with lower feelings of happiness.

questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

❌ ④ experienced: 'the sufferings they have experienced' — 현재완료(have + p.p.) 구조에서 과거분사 정상.
det.tip: be grounded in = ~에 근거를 두다 (수동태). grounding(능동)은 오류.

questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: ①that=관계대명사(정상) ②that→those 오류(대명사those+who 필수) ③remarkably=부사(정상) ④suffering=동명사(정상)

det.korean: ①endure(견디다) ②investigated(조사했다) ③focused(집중했다) ④amplify(증폭시키다←reduce)
det.analysis:
❌ ① endure: '우리가 견디는 어려운 시간들' — 어려움을 '견딘다'는 문맥에 적절.

❌ ② investigated: '연구 프로젝트가 차이를 조사했다' — 연구의 행위로 적절.

❌ ③ focused: '연구자들이 초점을 맞췄다' — 연구의 방향을 나타내므로 적절.

det.tip: reduce(줄이다) ↔ amplify(증폭시키다). 고통 경험은 행복 수준을 줄인다.

det.korean: ①play(역할을 하다) ②overlap(겹치다) ③celebrating(축하하는←worrying) ④associated(연관된)
det.analysis:
❌ ① play: '어려운 시간이 핵심적 역할을 한다' — play a key role 관용 표현으로 적절.

❌ ② overlap: '행복한 삶과 의미 있는 삶이 상당 부분 겹친다' — 원문 그대로 적절.

✅ ③ celebrating: '의미 있는 삶을 산 사람들은 더 많이 축하하고(celebrating)' — 원문은 'worrying(걱정하는)'으로, 의미 있는 삶을 산 사람들이 '더 많이 걱정했다'는 맥락. 축하는 부정적 경험과의 연관성이라는 전체 논지와 불일치. ← 정답

❌ ④ associated: '이 사건들이 낮은 행복감과 연관되어 있다' — 원문 그대로 적절.
det.tip: worrying(걱정하는) ↔ celebrating(축하하는). 의미 있는 삶은 더 많은 걱정과 스트레스를 수반.

✅ ① 의미 있는 삶을 산 사람들은 과거 부정적 사건을 더 많이 겪었다고 보고했다.

→ 본문: 'overlap a great deal'이지만 'distinct from happiness'인 측면에 초점. 완전히 동일하지 않음.

→ 본문: 'tended to reduce people's overall levels of happiness' — 줄이는 것이지 높이는 것이 아님.

❌ ④ 사르트르는 인간의 삶이 행복에서 시작된다고 주장했다.
→ 본문: 'on the far side of despair(절망의 저편)' — 행복이 아닌 절망.

questions.passage: The difficult times that we endure play __________. As Jean-Paul Sartre put it, "Human life begins on the far side of despair." That is, many of the ways people feel their lives are meaningful are grounded in the sufferings they have experienced. One research project investigated the differences between people who found their lives to be happy and those who found them to be meaningful. While, on average, happy lives and meaningful lives overlap a great deal, the researchers focused on those aspects of a meaningful life that were distinct from happiness. And, remarkably, they found that people who had more meaningful lives reported that they had more experience suffering through past negative events. They also reported worrying more and enduring more things that caused them stress. On the other hand, these past experiences with suffering tended to reduce people's overall levels of happiness. Our sufferings, then, seem to help to provide people with the sense that their lives are more meaningful, even if these events are associated with lower feelings of happiness.

다음 우리말에 맞도록 빈칸에 들어갈 알맞은 말을 영어로 쓰시오. (영어로)
우리말: 우리가 더 의미 있는 삶을 이끌도록 돕는 데 핵심적인 역할을 한다
[조건] (1) a, helping, in, key, lead, lives, meaningful, more, role, to, us를 모두 사용 (2) 정확히 11단어로 쓸 것

det.korean: 더 의미 있는 삶을 이끌도록 돕는 데 핵심적 역할
det.analysis:
본문: 'play a key role in helping us to lead more meaningful lives'

• a key role: '핵심적인 역할' — play의 목적어
• in helping us: '우리를 돕는 데' — 전치사 in + 동명사
• to lead more meaningful lives: '더 의미 있는 삶을 이끌도록' — help + 목적어 + to부정사

11단어. play는 주절 동사로 조건에 포함되지 않음.
det.tip: play a key role in -ing = ~하는 데 핵심 역할을 하다. help + 목적어 + to부정사 구조.
